messages.signupClosed: Sign-up is closed. Ask an admin to open it.
messages.passwordRequired: Sign up with a password. You can add a passkey once your account exists.

gate.loadError: Elysium could not check who is signed in.

login.heading: Sign in
login.passkeyFailed: The passkey did not sign you in. Try again, or use your password.
login.loadError: The sign-in form could not load. Refresh the page to try again.
login.expired: That sign-in took too long, so it started over. Try again.
login.disabledNotice: Your account is disabled. Ask an admin to enable it.

refresh.heading: Confirm it's you
refresh.description: Changing how you sign in needs a recent sign-in. Enter your password or use a passkey.

secondFactor.heading: Two-step verification
secondFactor.description: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.

signup.heading: Create your account
signup.description: An admin approves every new account before it can use the workspace.
signup.firstDescription: Nobody has signed up yet. You will be this workspace's admin.
signup.loadError: The sign-up form could not load. Refresh the page to try again.

closed.heading: Sign-up is closed
closed.description: This workspace is not accepting new accounts. Ask an admin to open sign-up, or sign in if you already have an account.

recovery.heading: Reset your password
recovery.description: Enter your account's email. Elysium makes a one-time link that signs you in so you can choose a new password.
recovery.loadError: The recovery form could not load. Refresh the page to try again.

sent.title: Ask an admin for your link
sent.description: If that address has an account, a recovery link was made. Elysium can't send email yet, so the link is in the server's log: ask an admin to pass it on. It works once, for 15 minutes.

pending.heading: Waiting for approval
pending.description: Thanks for signing up, {{name}}. An admin needs to approve your account before you can use the workspace.
pending.automatic: This page opens the workspace on its own once you're approved.

error.heading: Something went wrong
error.description: That link or form is no longer valid.

security.title: Sign-in & security
security.loadError: Your security settings could not load.
security.expired: The page was open too long, so it reloaded. Make your change again.

enrollment.title: Set up an authenticator app
enrollment.description: This workspace requires two-step verification. Set up an authenticator app below to continue.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name is shown to everyone in the workspace. You sign in with your email.

password.title: Password
password.description: Choose a new password. Every other device you're signed in on is signed out.
password.saved: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

authenticator.title: Authenticator app
authenticator.description: Asks for a six-digit code from an app such as Bitwarden, 1Password, or Google Authenticator after you sign in.
authenticator.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
authenticator.manualKey: Or enter this key by hand:
authenticator.enterCode: Then enter the six-digit code it shows.
authenticator.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
authenticator.removeMessage: You will no longer be asked for a code after signing in.

lookup.title: Lookup codes
lookup.description: One-time codes that stand in for your authenticator app if you lose it. Keep them somewhere safe.
lookup.saveThem: Save these codes now. They replace your old ones once you confirm.
lookup.regenerated: New codes created. Save them, then confirm.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in without a password, using a passkey kept by your password manager, such as Bitwarden, or by your browser.
passkeys.removeMessage: You can no longer sign in with “{{name}}”.
passkeys.lastWay: This is your last way to sign in, so it can't be removed.

sessions.title: Where you're signed in
sessions.description: Every browser and device signed in to your account.
sessions.othersEnded: Every other device was signed out.
